item.title: Tens of Thousands of Pro-Monarchist Iranians Rally Against Regime in Munich
item.description: Tens of thousands of pro-Monarchist Iranians gathered in Munich, Germany, to protest the Iranian regime.

item.title: Washington Police Stop Suspected Drunk Driver Using Grappler After Wrong-Way Chase
item.description: Washington police say a suspected drunk driver was brought to a stop with a grappler after fleeing a traffic stop and driving the wrong way.

item.title: Tri-State Area Forecast: Light Snow Expected Sunday Night into Monday, 1–2 Inches Likely
item.description: ❄️ TRI-STATE AREA: A light snowfall is possible Sunday night into Monday, with minor accumulations expected. Forecast totals generally range from 1 to 2 inches across the New York City metro area, northeast New Jersey, and Long Island. Areas north of the city are expected to see lighter amounts.

item.title: Teen Saves Child Who Fell Through Ice in Queens
item.description: A teenager jumped into action after seeing a child fall through the ice in Queens on Friday afternoon.

item.title: IDF Launches Airstrikes in Khan Yunis, Gaza

item.title: SpaceX Falcon 9 Launches 24 Starlink Satellites from Vandenberg
item.description: SpaceX launches a Falcon 9 from Vandenberg Space Force Base, sending 24 Starlink satellites to low-Earth orbit.

item.title: Four Astronauts from U.S., France, Russia Arrive at ISS, Restoring Full Crew Capacity
item.description: Four astronauts from the U.S., France, and Russia arrived at the ISS on Saturday for an eight- to nine-month mission, returning the station to full capacity after a January medical emergency cut a previous crew’s stay short.
